policy.single_bins: floor(log(P_um/0.85)/log(1.005)); fixed geometric bins, upper bound exclusive
policy.ranking: risk starts low first; then max minimum block purity, sum, lower F512, shorter k, spec and source; missing purity ranks below any measured purity
policy.multi_targets: unordered period_T tuple rounded to 9 decimals, plus target shares when unequal (weights, aligned to periods_T); ranking uses min(purity/weight); line metrics retain source order
policy.unknown_metrics: Legacy scores are not asserted to be whole-block purity; CSV model risk retained; ladder risk UNKNOWN without source classification
policy.conflicts: All different period sets per exact uppercase spec flagged at 9 decimal T precision, including within-source target differences; no physical-period inference
policy.delta: dimensionless positive tangential direction difference; first order lambda_nm=1000*P_um*delta; not an angle
policy.units: T=0.13333 um for all canonical periods; source rounded um retained in raw; F512 is percent
